gui.luminance.shader.minecraft.antialias: Smooths jagged edges by blending nearby pixels.
gui.luminance.shader.minecraft.art.descr: Softens pixels outward, moving objects shimmer slightly.
gui.luminance.shader.minecraft.bits.desc: Reduces resolution, and limits colours to an 8-bit palette.
gui.luminance.shader.minecraft.bloom.des: Adds a cinematic brightness-based bloom, as seen in 23w13a_or_b; The Vote Update.
gui.luminance.shader.minecraft.bumpy.des: Outlines colour differences, and giving textures a 3D appearance.
gui.luminance.shader.minecraft.deconverg: Offsets the red, green, and blue colour channels.
gui.luminance.shader.minecraft.desaturat: Drastically reduces the intensity of colours.
gui.luminance.shader.minecraft.fxaa.desc: Adds a small amount of anti-aliasing, smoothing jagged edges.
gui.luminance.shader.minecraft.green.des: Simulates the look of a CRT display, without blurring, reduces resolution, limits colours to an 8-bit palette, and adds a green tint.
gui.luminance.shader.minecraft.notch.des: Halves the resolution, uses a 8-bit colour palette, and renders a dithering effect.
gui.luminance.shader.minecraft.ntsc.desc: Simulates the look of a CRT display.
gui.luminance.shader.minecraft.outline.d: Outlines colour differences similarly to Bumpy, but less complex.
gui.luminance.shader.minecraft.pencil.de: Monochromatic with occasional outlines, resulting in a sketch-like aesthetic.
Leaves motion trails behind moving objects.
gui.luminance.shader.minecraft.scan_pinc: Simulates the look of a CRT display, without blurring.
gui.luminance.shader.minecraft.shareware: Boosts saturation, reduces resolution, and applies a posterized colour palette, as seen in 3D Shareware v1.34.
gui.luminance.shader.minecraft.sobel.des: Only renders colour on edges, rendering everything else black.
gui.luminance.shader.minecraft.wobble.de: Continuously cycles colours through the hue range, whilst oscillating pixels in a sine wave.
gui.luminance.shader.minecraft.love.desc: Adds a red tint, as seen in 15w14a; The Love and Hugs Update.
